Definition: Share of submitted, indexable priority category/product/guide URLs indexed after launch stabilization.
Measurement: GSC Page Indexing + URL Inspection sample; indexed eligible URLs divided by eligible submitted URLs; exclude intentionally noindex URLs.
ProposedTarget: At least 95% by 90 days after stable launch, with zero unresolved critical template-level indexing defects. Search engines decide indexation.
Frequency: Weekly during launch; monthly after stabilization
Baseline: No domain or GSC property supplied; not measurable yet.

Definition: Search visibility for TechFind pages in Google Search.
Measurement: GSC Web search impressions; filter Pakistan, brand/nonbrand query set, page type, and period.
ProposedTarget: Establish first 90-day baseline; then seek 20% year-over-year impressions growth by month 12, seasonality adjusted, as a planning target.
Baseline: No historical data; query mix and SERP changes affect counts.

Definition: Visits initiated from Google organic results.
Measurement: GSC clicks by country/page/query; compare equivalent periods and inspect brand/nonbrand separately.
ProposedTarget: After baseline, seek 20% year-over-year clicks growth by month 12, adjusted for seasonality and material catalog changes.
Baseline: Provisional target; not a forecast or guarantee.

Definition: Clicks divided by impressions for eligible query/page groups.
Measurement: GSC clicks divided by impressions; segment by query intent, brand status, position band and template.
ProposedTarget: Improve CTR versus baseline on priority pages after controlling for position and query mix; set numeric threshold after baseline.
Baseline: No universal CTR target; avoid aggregate comparisons with changing query mix.

Definition: Qualified organic entrances to priority commerce templates.
Measurement: GA4 landing page + session source/medium; reconcile trends with GSC clicks.
ProposedTarget: Set baseline for first 90 days; grow qualified priority-template organic sessions year over year; set numeric target after catalog/baseline review.
Baseline: GA4 not connected; consent and attribution need QA.

Definition: Share of active priority SKUs with indexable, canonical, complete product pages.
Measurement: Catalog export joined to crawl + GSC index status; define active/eligible SKU rules.
ProposedTarget: 100% of approved priority active SKUs have a complete canonical URL and accurate visible availability/price policy before launch.
Baseline: Depends on product inventory and feed.

Definition: Product-detail views from organic landing sessions.
Measurement: GA4 item_view/view_item events segmented by session source and landing template.
ProposedTarget: Improve product-view rate against baseline; set numeric goal after event QA and sufficient sample.
Baseline: Event schema and ecommerce tagging not provided.

Definition: Organic sessions with add_to_cart divided by eligible organic product sessions.
Measurement: GA4 ecommerce events and sessions filtered to organic source; QA deduplication.
ProposedTarget: Proposed 10% relative improvement versus first stable 90-day baseline by month 12, subject to sufficient traffic and merchandising comparability.

Definition: Purchases divided by organic sessions (or clearly stated user/session denominator).
Measurement: GA4 purchase event and order backend reconciliation; report session and user definitions consistently.
ProposedTarget: First establish clean baseline; then test for 10% relative improvement over baseline by month 12. No absolute sales target until margins/operations are known.
Baseline: No customer/order data; small samples can make rate volatile.

Definition: Business outcomes attributed to organic sessions.
Measurement: GA4 purchase value reconciled with order system, refunds/cancellations and attribution window.
ProposedTarget: Set target after margin, stock, conversion baseline and attribution validation; report as actual only when reconciled.
Baseline: No sales or margin inputs supplied.

Definition: Share of organic sessions meeting engaged-session definition and meaningful content/product interaction.
Measurement: GA4 engaged sessions / organic sessions; supplement with product views and contact events.
ProposedTarget: Improve versus validated baseline; inspect by page template and device rather than impose a universal rate.
Baseline: GA4 definition may change; no tracking baseline.

Definition: User experience signals on eligible page groups.
Measurement: CrUX/Search Console CWV report; PSI diagnostics as laboratory context.
ProposedTarget: Aim for Good CWV at 75th percentile for at least 75% of measurable priority URL groups, once eligible field data exists.
Baseline: No live URLs; not all URLs have CrUX data.

Definition: High-impact errors blocking crawl, indexation, product facts, or checkout.
Measurement: Crawl + GSC + release QA issue register, with severity and affected templates.
ProposedTarget: Zero open critical SEO defects at each approved release; resolve or document owner/ETA for high-severity items.
Baseline: Requires domain, staging and developer access.

Definition: Share of required events/fields passing agreed data QA.
Measurement: Test purchases and analytics QA checklist; compare GA4 events to backend order records.
ProposedTarget: 100% of required ecommerce events and consent behavior pass pre-launch QA; order reconciliation tolerance to be agreed by analytics owner.
Baseline: Tolerance and data governance must be agreed; not yet implemented.

Definition: Priority guides/pages with current facts and valid internal links.
Measurement: Editorial inventory review with owner, review date, accuracy checks and inventory links.
ProposedTarget: 100% of priority guides have an assigned owner and review date; review quarterly or after material model/policy changes.
Baseline: Process target; content is not researched or published yet.
